div.head: Hn Lond 3
div.ab: Et si quis civium de placitis coronae implacitatus fuerit, per sacramentum quod iudicatum fuerit in civitate, se disrationet homo London.
And if any of the citizens has become involved in a plea of the crown, he shall clear himself, as a citizen of London, by an oath which has been decreed in the city.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 288–289 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
